summary.name: YourMove AI
summary.one_liner: YourMove AI is an AI texting assistant for dating apps that suggests opening lines, replies, profile bios, and profile feedback.
use_cases: Coming up with opening lines for dating app matches
Drafting replies to messages received on dating apps
Writing or improving a dating profile bio
Getting feedback on why a dating profile gets few matches
Generating messages in another language such as Spanish
summary.what_it_does: The tool generates three personalized openers from a typed topic or a screenshot of a profile, which the page says takes about 5 seconds or less. Users paste a message they received and get suggested responses. A profile writer turns user-provided details into a dating bio, and a profile review feature gives feedback and suggestions for improving a profile. Message suggestions can be selected in styles such as flirty or thoughtful. The page is mostly testimonials and marketing, so details beyond these features are not stated.
notable: Screenshot-based opener generation for dating profiles
Profile writer and data-driven profile review in one tool
Offers flirty or thoughtful tone options for replies
caveats: Pricing tiers and paid limits are not described on the page; the 'freemium' label comes from the directory listing
Page testimonials mention the app crashing for one user with long input, and users asking for deeper app integration
Effectiveness claims such as 4x matches come from marketing and are not independently verified
